patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.chiefComplaint: Fever after returning from the Congo
clinical.quoteLong: I got back from the DRC eight days ago. I was treating patients during the outbreak, and one shift my glove tore while I was cleaning up vomit. Yesterday the fever and body aches started; today I've vomited twice.
clinical.presentationShort: 39yo F aid doctor - returned from DRC 8 days ago after direct body-fluid exposure with torn PPE. Fever, severe myalgia, headache and vomiting since yesterday.
clinical.presentationLong: 39-year-old female international aid physician who returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo eight days ago after a torn glove during direct contact with a febrile patient's vomit, now with acute fever, severe myalgia, headache and vomiting.

diagnosis.primary: Suspected Ebola disease after high-risk occupational exposure
diagnosis.disposition: Resus -> immediate single-room isolation with appropriate PPE, notify infection control and public health, coordinate Ebola testing while urgently evaluating malaria and other likely causes
diagnosis.why: Travel alone is not enough. This patient has all three pieces: compatible acute illness, return within the 21-day window and a direct body-fluid exposure through compromised PPE. Isolate first and notify public health, but do not let the Ebola concern delay testing and treatment for malaria or other common lethal infections.
diagnosis.redFlag: Fever within 21 days of a high-risk body-fluid exposure in an Ebola-affected area.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 39-year-old female international aid doctor in practical travel clothes, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: slumped forward with elbows near her knees, one hand holding her aching head and a plain travel duffel beside the chair
signs: weak aching posture without any bleeding
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style with smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines, warm detailed rendering and natural realistic proportions. Match the attached reference image's painterly style. Full-body wide shot, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, centered. Show the entire person, entire blue padded clinic chair and plain travel duffel with all feet and chair legs and generous margin. Subject: a white 39-year-old female international aid doctor in practical neutral travel clothes with no organization logo. Pose: slumped forward, one hand holding her aching head, travel duffel beside the chair. Expression: feverish, exhausted and seriously ill. Visible signs: flushed sweaty face, heavy tired eyes, weak myalgic posture. Absolutely no blood, bleeding, rash, gore, vomit, PPE costume or sensational imagery. No text, logos, shadows, floor plane, watermark or border. Perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background.
